card.name: Dosing-instruction wording before thresholds
card.fires_on: Words in the middle of dosing or monitoring instructions, such as 'administration', 'checks', 'can', 'exceeds' and 'than', right before a time, limit or action is stated. Mostly verbs and linking words in rule-like sentences.

modes.label: Timing rules
modes.description: Words in sentences about timing around administration or observation periods.
modes.example: (IV infusion or IV push)<< can>> be reduced to 15 minutes.

modes.label: Threshold wording
modes.description: Words that introduce a limit or cutoff value.
modes.example: If the serum potassium<< exceeds>> 6.5 mEq/liter

card.plain: It fires on the connecting words in instructions just before a time or limit is given.
